definitions.explanation: A licensed professional who cares for and educates young children at nursery schools and daycare facilities. This is an official qualification requiring a national exam in Japan.

examples.japanese: {姉|あね}は{保育士|ほいくし}です。
examples.english: My older sister is a nursery teacher.

examples.japanese: {保育士|ほいくし}の{資格|しかく}を{取|と}りたい。
examples.english: I want to get a nursery teacher qualification.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}では{保育士|ほいくし}が{不足|ふそく}していて、{待機|たいき}{児童|じどう}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: There is a shortage of childcare workers in this area, and the number of children on waiting lists is increasing.

notes:
A nationally licensed childcare professional who works at {保育園|ほいくえん} (nursery schools) or {認定|にんてい}こども{園|えん} (certified children's centers). The qualification requires passing a national exam or graduating from a designated training program.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保育士|ほいくし}{資格|しかく}: nursery teacher qualification
- {保育士|ほいくし}{不足|ふそく}: shortage of childcare workers
- {保育士|ほいくし}{試験|しけん}: nursery teacher exam
- {保育士|ほいくし}{養成|ようせい}: nursery teacher training

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {幼稚園|ようちえん}{教諭|きょうゆ}: kindergarten teacher — works at kindergartens under the Ministry of Education, whereas {保育士|ほいくし} works at nursery schools under the Ministry of Health
- {保育|ほいく}{者|しゃ}: childcare provider — a more general term not tied to the specific national qualification
